links.outcome: Sensitivity and NPV for safe worklist deprioritization of remarkable NCCT examinations (external validation, n=2001)
links.effect: Standalone commercial detectors left 31 of 324 remarkable examinations deprioritized (16 target-disease false negatives, 15 outside their indications). The collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination, with 100% sensitivity and NPV, while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20).
links.tradeoff: Only 18% of examinations were deprioritized under the safety-first rule, since an exam is deprioritized only when no model returns a positive result.
links.quote: In contrast, the collaborative system recovered every remarkable examination at a threshold prespecified in the development cohort, achieving 100% sensitivity and NPV while deprioritizing 18% of examinations (368/2001; 95% CI, 17–20).

design_hint: collaborative generalist-specialist AI safety net for worklist deprioritization with prespecified threshold
